messages:
Jordan (Support): Hey team — customer on Dedicated reported 500s after upgrading the python client to 2.0.0. They also see duplicate billing lines. Error looks like a surprising kwarg removal: 'timeout_ms'. Is this a known breaking change? ticket #INC-4821

Mike (SDK): We shipped the 2.0.0 client with a couple of intentional API changes: renamed timeout args and tightened model ABI. We did not mean to drop compat aliases. Also changed the default retry behavior for non-idempotent requests (bad timing). Can you paste a minimal repro? @Sara (Platform) fyi. :thinking:

Jordan (Support): Repro from customer (minimal):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="x", timeout_ms=2000)
resp = client.generate("Summarize this text")
```
Stack: TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'timeout_ms'
They then see two requests with the same input id and two small charges in invoice-lines.

Sara (Platform): Thanks. Quick workaround until we ship a compat patch: pin the client to the latest 1.x patch which keeps the old kwargs and retry semantics. e.g.
```
# recommended temporary pin
pip install "redwood-python==1.34.2"
```
Or migrate to the 2.x API by changing the constructor and retry config:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="x", timeout=2.0, retry_policy={"mode":"idempotent_only"})
```
The new timeout is seconds (float) and the retry defaults changed.

Mike (SDK): Confirming — 2.0.0 renamed timeout_ms -> timeout (seconds) and unintentionally widened retry scope. We will cut 2.0.1 to reintroduce a compat alias that raises a deprecation warning instead of hard error. Until then, advise pin to 1.34.2 and request a billing review for duplicate charges.

Jordan (Support): I pushed the pin guidance to the customer. They asked how to detect if they were double-charged — any specific logs to pull?

Mike (SDK): Grab request IDs and model request timestamps from Dedicated logs; look for identical input hashes with two distinct upstream request_ids within ~1s. Example log fields:
```
request_id=abcd1234 input_hash=e7f3... status=200 tokens=45
request_id=efgh5678 input_hash=e7f3... status=200 tokens=45
```
If you see that pattern, escalate to billing with the two request IDs and the customer org id. We'll mark the 2.0.0 tag and prioritize the 2.0.1 compat patch.

Emma (Oncall): Escalating to releases + billing. I've created ENG-PLATFORM-789 and billing case BILL-392. deploy-bot queued a patch branch for SDK with compat alias.

deploy-bot: Patch branch created: fix/sdk/compat-timeout-retry-435000. CI triggered.

Jordan (Support): Customer pinned to 1.34.2 and asked for ETA on a patch and billing credit. I've sent the billing case with the two request ids. They appreciated the quick workaround. :thumbsup:

Mike (SDK): We'll aim to cut 2.0.1 within 48 hours. Follow-up: we'll add an explicit deprecation warning in release notes and a migration snippet.

Jordan (Support): Thanks everyone — closing this thread once 2.0.1 is out and billing responds.
